summary: Garment bag lost on the way to a conference in Singapore
story: I flew from Raleigh to Singapore on June 13 to speak at a conference, and my checked garment bag did not arrive with me. Meridian Air searched for three weeks, declared it lost on July 6 and paid me $500. The bag held the suit, shirts and ties I had bought for the trip, my dress shoes, and my camera and portrait lens, because I was staying on for three days to photograph the botanic gardens. I gave my talk in chinos from the hotel gift shop, which have the word Singapore down one leg. Everything is listed at what I paid, and the receipts and my card statement are attached.

documents.content: Meridian Air property irregularity report SIN-MA-51127. Passenger Julian Okoro arrived Singapore SIN June 14, 2026 on MA 31 from Raleigh-Durham via San Francisco. One checked garment bag, tag MA 660418, not delivered.

documents.name: Meridian Air settlement letter
documents.content: Meridian Air, July 6, 2026. Dear Mr. Okoro, after a search of 21 days we have been unable to find your bag, tag MA 660418, and we now treat it as lost. We have paid $500.00 to your card in full settlement of our liability.
